description: Django REST Framework serializers for various models in a Learning Management Platform, including user, course, quiz, and progress serialization.

classes.name: RoleSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for Role model, including nested permissions.

classes.name: CourseSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for Course with basic fields.

classes.name: EnrollmentSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for Enrollment with validation to prevent duplicates.

classes.name: ChoiceSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for Choice with write-only is_correct.

classes.name: QuestionSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for Question with nested choices.

classes.name: QuizSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for Quiz with nested questions.

classes.name: AnswerSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for Answer, including selected choices.

classes.name: QuizAttemptSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for QuizAttempt with scoring logic in update.

classes.name: LearningPathSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for LearningPath with nested items.

classes.name: ReportCourseProgressSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for aggregating course progress data.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a QuizAttempt and associated answers atomically.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Marks attempt as completed, triggers scoring.

methods.name: _score_attempt
methods.description: Calculates and updates the score and pass status for a quiz attempt.
